manifest.source: SAT Competition 2024 Main original CNF bytes
manifest.selection: All archive Simon r16..r21 entries, based only on filename/round count; plus 4 SHA-pinned large controls. Local mode only includes previously downloaded members.
manifest.training: none; every trial a fresh process; ordinary CDCL clause learning enabled in all arms
manifest.metric: Verified PAR2 uses solver wall time including startup, parse, proof emission, excluding independent checking (reported separately). Missed cap/unknown/unverified=2*cap. Do not pool cohorts with different caps.

limitations: Application-derived reduced-round cipher encodings; not full-strength cryptanalysis or a representative industrial suite.
Large controls are outside current COOP1 size gate; their results do not measure active cooperation.
Repeated timings are not independent new formulas; no significance claim from a few correlated Simon instances.
Proof-producing reference configurations; not a comparison against separately tuned no-proof modes.
